claim: Making .contents a flex container turns the header-extra-info Ember component's wrapper <div> into a flex item with min-width:auto, so long topic titles (white-space:nowrap) can no longer shrink/ellipsize and overflow the header, pushing or overlapping the .panel icons.

body:
## [ISSUE] `order(2)` on `.extra-info-wrapper` has no effect -- it is not a child of the flex container

**Severity:** LOW -- dead CSS today; ordering only works by accident of `.panel`'s `order: 3`.

### The Problem

```scss
.extra-info-wrapper {
  @include order(2);
```

`order` only applies to flex items (direct children of a flex container). `header.hbs:93-95` renders `{{header-extra-info}}` inside `.contents`, but `HeaderExtraInfo` has no `tagName`/`classNames`, so the DOM is:

```
.contents (flex)
  div.title          (home-logo)
  div.panel          (order 3)
  div.ember-view     <- flex item, order 0
    div.extra-info-wrapper   <- order(2) applied here, ignored
```

### Theory / Proof

CSS Flexbox Level 1 section 5.4: "The order property controls the order in which flex items appear". Non-flex-items ignore it.

### What happens today vs. what will break

Visual order is still logo, extra-info, panel only because `.panel` gets `order: 3` and the ember div keeps 0. Any future element added to `.contents` (plugin outlet, etc.) will be positioned relative to order 0, not 2, contrary to the intent expressed here. The rule is also global (not scoped to `.d-header`).

### Recommendation

Put the class on the component element so the rule targets the flex item:

```js
classNames: ['extra-info-wrapper'],
```

and remove the wrapper div from `header-extra-info.hbs`, or scope the rule as `.d-header .contents > .ember-view`.

claim: Mobile rule `.small-action .custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` compensated for the removed 4em left padding; with padding now 1.5%, the custom message is pulled ~35px left over the avatar icon on mobile.

.small-action-desc is now a flex item without flex-grow, so it shrinks to its content width and the edit/delete buttons (float:right inside it) no longer sit at the right edge of the 755px row but right next to the description text.
align-items mixin passes the modern value verbatim to -webkit-box-align/-ms-flex-align, which use start/end instead of flex-start/flex-end, and emits the non-existent property -ms-align-items.
